mapper.sql: p.*, w.name AS warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, au.nickname AS approve_by_name, COALESCE(agg.item_count, 0) AS item_count, COALESCE(agg.ordered_qty, 0) AS ordered_qty, COALESCE(agg.arrived_qty, 0) AS arrived_qty

FROM ecom_purchase_plan p LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = p.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = p.approve_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT it.plan_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS ordered_qty, SUM(COALESCE(arr.qty, 0)) AS arrived_qty FROM ecom_purchase_plan_item it LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = it.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT oi.order_id, oi.material_id, SUM(oi.done_qty) AS qty FROM scm_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT x.order_id FROM ecom_purchase_plan_item x WHERE x.order_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.material_id) arr ON arr.order_id = it.order_id AND arr.material_id = it.material_id GROUP BY it.plan_id) agg ON agg.plan_id = p.id
mapper.select:
SELECT
p.status = #{status}
AND (p.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_purchase_plan_item k LEFT JOIN wms_material km ON km.id = k.material_id WHERE k.plan_id = p.id AND (k.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR km.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR km.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))))
ORDER BY p.id DESC
